expected_defects.defect: scripts/deploy.sh hardcodes an absolute host path (/var/releases/live/)

expected_non_defects.feature: evals/results/run1/transcript.md quotes an absolute path found by a prior review
expected_non_defects.why: evals/results/ holds generated validation evidence (transcripts/results), not Skill product content; quoting a fixture's planted defect in a review write-up is not itself a defect of this package.

expected_non_defects.feature: evals/notes.md mentions a third-party Skill path (~/skills/pr-reviewer) as planning context
expected_non_defects.why: Narrative documents living directly in evals/ (validation plans, notes, handoffs) describe the validation process around the case corpus, not the inspected Skill's own content.

notes: Regression fixture for RG-010. evals/results/ and top-level evals/*.md documents began tripping RG-001 once generated review evidence and cross-host planning docs quoted example hardcoded paths from other fixtures. Fixed by extending the inspector's scan-exclusion boundary; this fixture keeps both directions honest: evidence/planning content is excluded, and a genuine hardcoded path in real script content (scripts/deploy.sh) is still caught.
